name: Antarctic Research Trust Habitat Restoration Grants
summary: Grants for individuals who restore or create native habitat on ungrazed islands, paying for commercially grown native plants and planting labour, with works completed within 12 months.

applicant_types.quote: ART grants for habitat restoration projects are for individuals interested in restoring and creating areas of native habitats for the benefit of people, wildlife and plants on islands that are ungrazed by livestock.
